classification_policy.DOOR_RECORD: type_ == 5; Room.GetDoorIndex scans ObjChip type 5; record identity is not inferred from raw map alone.
classification_policy.EQUIPMENT_NO_HP_EFFECT_PROVEN: type_ in {1,4} and recovery_ == 0; targetable by GotoEquip but no HP recovery is proven.
classification_policy.RECOVERY_EQUIPMENT: type_ in {1,4} and recovery_ >= 1; Staff.UseEquip adds recovery stock on completion.
classification_policy.REST/SOCIAL: No FurnitureData record is promoted as REST or SOCIAL from names or sprites. Rest is the Staff stay-home lifecycle; social goals are pass chips.
classification_policy.WORKSTATION: type_ == 2; Room.PlaceDesk and Staff desk ownership consume this class.
